messages:
jia: FYI — dashboard for runtime request-mix + cost-per-token is live in /dashboards/runtime/new-mix. Need to lock alert thresholds and pager routing before we roll to prod.
nathan: Nice. Can you paste the key metrics we want alerts on? error rate, latency p95, and error_budget burn? :eyes:
jia: Primary metrics: 
- runtime.request_errors_total (5m rate)
- runtime.latency_ms_p95
- runtime.token_cost_per_minute
- error_budget_burn_rate (derived)

sam: For paging, my proposal:
- P0 page if error rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 > 800ms for 5m
- P1 page if error rate > 0.4% for 10m OR p95 > 600ms for 10m
- Burn alert: page if error_budget_burn_rate > 2x for 30m (otherwise slack alert)

elaine: Sounds reasonable. Couple asks: 1) who owns initial triage (infra-oncall or runtime-oncall)? 2) do we want automatic fallback to cheaper model variant if capacity slippage? (ops concern)

nathan: ownership: infra-oncall for infra issues (GPU / region outage), runtime-oncall for model/runtime regressions. Add mapping in pagerduty: infra-oncall -> infra escalation, runtime-oncall -> runtime escalation. Fallback policy can be a separate runbook, not tied to pagering.

jia: +1. I'll add the runbook. For the alert defs I sketched a Prometheus rule — feedback welcome:

```
groups:
- name: redwood/runtime-alerts
  rules:
  - alert: RuntimeHighErrorRate
    expr: increase(runtime_request_errors_total[5m]) / increase(runtime_requests_total[5m]) > 0.01
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: page
    annotations:
      summary: "Runtime error rate > 1% (5m)"

  - alert: RuntimeLatencyP95High
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.8
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: page

  - alert: ErrorBudgetBurnHigh
    expr: error_budget_burn_rate > 2
    for: 30m
    labels:
      severity: page
```

sam: Two quick notes: 1) use metric names with dots -> underscores (we already have runtime_latency_p95). 2) set `severity: page` for P0 and `severity: high` for P1 so PD routing works.

elaine: Also recommend paging only when runbook link is attached. Add annotation `runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/runtime-high-error`

nathan: Agree. Also add `team: runtime` label so PagerDuty routing rules can pick it up.

eng-oncall-bot: New alert rule draft detected. Suggestion: add a suppression window for deploy-related alerts: `absent(deploy_in_progress{service="runtime"}) == 0` to mute during active deploys. :robot_face:

jia: Good call. We'll add `unless deploy_in_progress` clause.

sam: Quick PD mapping proposal:
- severity: page -> PagerDuty service: runtime-critical -> escalate to runtime primary -> 15m -> infra secondary
- severity: high -> PagerDuty service: runtime-high -> notify runtime slack only (no page)

nathan: For burn alerts that page, route first to runtime SRE then to platform lead if not acknowledged in 10m.

elaine: I'll update the dashboard docs with the thresholds and link to the runbook. After that we need a 2-day quiet window for tuning thresholds in staging then flip on pages for prod.

jia: Plan:
1) update rules (today)
2) add runbook + PD mappings (tomorrow)
3) quiet tuning in staging (2 days)
4) enable prod paging (after signoff)

sam: I'll create the PD services and add routing. Tagging @nathan for ownership handoff. :thumbsup:

nathan: Taking ownership of the runtime PD services. Will coordinate with oncall ops to add escalation policies.

eng-oncall-bot: Deployment reminder scheduled: staging tuning window starts 1842110500.

jia: Thanks everyone — I’ll open a PR with the alert rules and runbook link, ping when ready for review. :pray:
